scope: Observed A–F caller workflow on actual local HTTP Worker with Wrangler D1; read-only independent assessment. Successful RPC alone is not the verdict.

outcomes.evidence: Eight original inputs were separately captured as ordinary actions before classification; exact notes and original identities survive final revision 49.
Someday/Maybe, Reference and Undecided remain uncommitted; no invented read action, due date, defer or project commitment. Caller tags carry semantics independently of active lifecycle.

C supplies exact deadline instants, timezone, commitments and category decisions before caller action; no repeated or unnecessary questions observed. Handling an actually missing essential decision was not exercised.
Tax due 2026-10-20T14:59Z and electricity due 2026-10-12T14:59Z match explicit 23:59 Asia/Tokyo. Proposal preference retains null Due/Defer.
Tax and Kyoto have captured roots with four source-supported concrete child actions, explicit catalog membership and intended sibling order; no prerequisite or blocking semantics added.

D reports all 12 unfinished records, waiting/reference/someday groups, both committed project next actions and reasoned focus choices. D contains only reads at revision 44; nonselected records remain inspectable. F all-unfinished includes deferred packing.

User-reported landlord reply changes on-hold to active without completion/new follow-up. Receipt collection child completes while tax parent remains active; Fill the form becomes selected next action.
Preview uses date 2026-10-10 plus Asia/Tokyo and commit uses resolved 2026-10-10T00:00:00.000Z. Packing alone is deferred until local 09:00.

F is read-only revision 49; returns four same-ID actionable leaves and excludes reference/someday/undecided, unspecified landlord follow-up and deferred packing. Five existing perspectives stay unchanged; no duplicate/recreated records or new temporary view.

Playbook supplies reusable prompt, live-discovery/read requirements, semantic boundaries, stable IDs, five filter definitions and recovery rules. Fresh caller execution is pending separately; generic tag descriptions do not themselves define classification rules.

All 49 persisted operation receipts independently read as applied and match chronological write responses; no API failure/retry occurred. Unknown outcome/conflict behavior is documented but not exercised.
Scenario avoids repeated classification questions and preserves noncommitments. Sustained real-user reduction in remembering/management effort was not measured.

firstFailures.failure: First finalizer failed because post-call state assignment was not flushed; reconstructed capture/final snapshots from retained actual calls. No API failure or retry.
firstFailures.disposition: Caller reconstructed missing cached snapshots from retained actual responses. Independent fresh snapshot and receipt reads corroborate persisted state; no saved-data/API failure observed.

definitionGaps: Generic tag descriptions only state caller classification; Actionable and Next action semantics are defined in playbook, but Reference/Someday/Undecided largely depend on ordinary meaning and scenario examples.
limitations: No actually-missing essential clarification decision, unknown response, conflict, fresh-context rerun or sustained user-benefit test in this A–F run.
Hosted D1, trusted Sites authentication and ChatGPT UI acceptance are outside this selected local run; another host is not a failure criterion.
summaryJa: A–F の観測成果は合格。再利用性・未情報時の確認・障害回復・実ユーザー負担軽減は未実証のため全体は条件付き。
